iterations.plan: Implement scoring logic with 10 frames, handling strike/spare bonuses only from existing rolls and special 10th frame rules.
iterations.code:
def house_bowling(rolls: list[int]) -> int:
    score = 0
    i = 0  # index into rolls

    # Frames 1 through 9
    for _ in range(9):
        if rolls[i] == 10:  # strike
            score += 10
            # Add next two rolls if they exist
            if i + 1 < len(rolls):
                score += rolls[i + 1]
            if i + 2 < len(rolls):
                score += rolls[i + 2]
            i += 1
        else:
            first = rolls[i]
            second = rolls[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(rolls) else 0
            frame_total = first + second
            if frame_total == 10:  # spare
                score += 10
                if i + 2 < len(rolls):
                    score += rolls[i + 2]
            else:
                score += frame_total
            i += 2

    # Frame 10: just sum the remaining rolls (either 1 or 2)
    # According to the house rule, no extra bonus rolls are granted.
    while i < len(rolls):
        score += rolls[i]
        i += 1

    return score
